610721.en: Right, just take the ingot. You don't need me anyway, but don't come crawling back when you get into trouble...
610721.ch: 你行，这块破铁你拿去好了，反正也不需要我，到时候出了事可别急得抓耳挠腮，哼哼……

610724.en: You must have what it takes to find our land. Do you have it?
610724.ch: 能寻至我族领地，想必你也自有一番机缘，也罢，东西可带了？

610726.en: I see. A young man that doesn't know our rules.
610726.ch: ……哦，原来是个不懂规矩的年轻人啊。

610727.en: I will make it very clear. You must present a gift if you want to enter.
610727.ch: 我且直言相告，如欲进入涂山，请先奉上觐见之礼。

610729.en: Wow, a fox that speaks like a human?! Grandpa was right after all!
610729.ch: 哇，原来八荒中真有会说人话的狐狸！爷爷果然没有骗我呀！

610731.en: But why did she leave right after? That was kind of rude.
610731.ch: 呃……不过，这狐狸丫头，怎么说完话就扭头走了，真没礼貌呢！

610732.en: I thought I finally met someone my age!
610732.ch: 啊！真的吗？人家还以为遇到了个同龄的小伙伴呢！

610733.en: I wanted to give her some of my candies...
610733.ch: 还想把兜里的饴糖分她一半……

610737.en: I have an idea. Foxes have always liked rare treasures. They'll love precious accessories, instruments or pottery!
610737.ch: 哦，这个我知道！狐狸向来喜欢奇珍异宝，你弄些极为珍贵的饰品、乐器、陶器等宝贝给他们，他们肯定乐意！

610738.ch: 你怎会知道得如此清楚？

610739.en: Several foxes came to our village once, and stole all of the valuables we had...
610739.ch: 以前村边来过几只狐狸，它们不仅偷鸡摸狗，还把村里仅剩的几件值钱玩意儿全偷走了……

610741.en: I'm kidding. Grandpa told me all about them. He knew everything!
610741.ch: 开玩笑的啦，其实这些都是爷爷告诉我的，我爷爷啥都知道，你说是不是很厉害！

610742.en: You humans are wise. I'm sure you can guess what we are after.
610742.ch: 以人类的灵智，想必你也能猜到我族所欲之物。

610743.en: However, since you didn't know about the gift, you naturally are not aware of the other rule.
610743.ch: 不过你既然不知这献宝进山之事，自然也不知这其中另外一道规矩。

610745.en: Again, I will make it clear. We will not return your gifts, whether we like it or not.
610745.ch: 此事还需事先言明，我等妖族收取人类之物，无论钟意与否都概不退还。

610746.en: If you present something that our Grand Elder doesn't like, you may not enter.
610746.ch: 倘若阁下所赠之礼不合我家大长老的心意，这涂山之门依旧不能对阁下敞开，此事还请阁下知悉。

610748.en: Please wait while I present your gift to the Grand Elder. You shall enter if the Grand Elder is pleased by your gift.
610748.ch: 阁下且等候于此，我将礼物呈于我家大长老，若其应允，我便让阁下进山。

610750.en: Congratulations. The Grand Elder likes your gift very much. You may come in.
610750.ch: 恭喜阁下，我家大长老对阁下之礼甚是满意，现邀阁下进山一叙。

610753.en: I am very sorry, but your gift was not satisfactory. Please leave. And one more thing... We are very interested in human music and rituals. I hope you understand what I meant.
610753.ch: 抱歉，阁下所献之物无法令我家大长老满意，还是请回吧……顺便说一句，我狐族对人类的礼乐之物颇感兴趣，是否理解全看阁下的悟性了。

610754.en: If you wish to enter, please prepare a gift.
610754.ch: 好，阁下若真想进山，请先准备妥当再来。

610758.en: Grand Elder, this is the mortal that presented you with the gift. What is...
610758.ch: 大长老，这位是刚刚奉上礼物得以进山的凡人，您这是……

610759.en: Yao, shut up and stand back!

610761.ch: 是他，的确是他！他回来了……

610762.ch: 他这一来，想必族长大人她……

610764.en: Demonic power explodes in the mountains behind the hall.
610764.ch: 突然间，一股妖力从后山冲天而起。

610765.en: Ru at your service, your majesty.

610768.en: The power and the iron ingot chase after one another in the air.
610768.ch: 这股妖力围绕着铁尺纠缠，二者在半空翻腾。

610771.en: Young men, this is our chief, Tu Shanjun.
610771.ch: 年轻人，此乃我九尾狐一族的族长，涂山珺大人。

610772.en: Why is she... just a spirit?
610772.ch: 她怎么只剩下一缕妖灵……

610773.en: You do not need to know why. She has commanded me to bring her out to meet someone from her time.
610773.ch: 此事你无需多问，如今旧人重逢，族长已传音命我助其显形。

610774.en: I need to prepare a spell here. Find us the Fox Spirit Orb so I may create a vessel for my chief.
610774.ch: 我需在此准备术法，你且去将狐灵宝玉夺回，如此方可为族长大人制作容器。

610776.en: Did you encounter any of our kind on the tundra?
610776.ch: 你可在此冰原中遇到过我族同类？

610777.en: They betrayed Tushan and turned on the humans. The other day, Hao even stole the Fox Spirit Orb...
610777.ch: 她们窃取灵玉，叛离涂山，对人类干戈相向……前日，阿皓更偷走了族内至宝狐灵宝玉，唉……

610779.en: I heard that their minds were corrupted by the deathly aura. The world is no longer at peace.
610779.ch: 听闻这些同胞也是受了冥气影响，被夺取了心智，这八荒越来越不太平了。

610780.en: Young men, do you have the Orb?
610780.ch: 年轻人，你可寻回了狐灵宝玉？

610781.en: Yes, this is our heirloom. Now I may prepare the spell.
610781.ch: 嗯，这的确就是我族的至宝，如此一来，我便可作法让族长之灵显形。

610782.en: Why are you wasting our time?
610782.ch: 既如此，阁下还是莫在此地耽误工夫。

610783.en: Orb in hand, Tu Shanru focuses her powers and casts a spell. In the blink of an eye, the Orb transforms into the shape of a fox, and the spirit quickly enters it.
610783.ch: 涂山茹手捧灵玉，施展全身妖力作起法来。不消多时，那块灵玉便化作一块狐形玉雕，而那盘旋空中的妖灵则眨眼间钻入了玉雕之中。

610784.en: And then the statue falls into your hands. You feel a refreshing aura caressing your mind.
610784.ch: 而这块玉雕，竟直直落入了你的手中，一股清凉的气息传遍你的全身，抚摸着你的思绪。

610785.en: Yu works day and night to try to alleviate the flood, and accidentally fell into the water one day. His assistants tried to save him with a pole, but they were all dragged into the water.
610785.ch: 阿禹在治水途中不辞辛劳，常常几日几夜未曾合眼。某天，阿禹实在疲乏难支，竟在治水途中不慎落水，几名助手想用竹竿拉住阿禹，结果被拖着全都跌入洪水，一时间情况万分危急。

610786.en: Then a white shadow floats down the mountain and jumps into the water.
610786.ch: 这时，一道白色的身影从远方山中飘飘而来，一闪便跃入水中。

610787.en: Some of Yu's people runs along the river, and finds a nine-tailed fox by the shore. Yu and others are on her tail.
610787.ch: 跟随阿禹的一众族人沿着洪水往下游追赶，不久后，他们在水岸边发现了一只九尾狐，阿禹和其他落水的人正躺倒在她的尾巴上。

610788.en: The fox notices them. It puts down Yu and others before going back into the mountain. Yu eventually wakes up, but the fox is already gone.
610788.ch: 狐狸见人来，把阿禹他们轻轻放下，随后朝大山深处跑去。众人上前救治，阿禹悠悠转醒，白狐早已消失无踪。

610791.en: Hahaha... You've been asking me to take break and take care of my self...
610791.ch: 哈哈……哈哈哈，你等总劝我要多休息，注意身体……咳咳……

610792.en: I told you I'm being watched by the gods and you don't need worry, but you didn't believe me!
610792.ch: 我早说了，我自有神明护佑，无需多虑，你等却还不信……

610793.en: I'm still alive, isn't that a sign that the gods above want me to overcome the flood? Do you believe me now?
610793.ch: 如今我大难不死，必然是上天护我，以助我降服八荒洪水！这回倒不由得你们不信了吧，哈哈哈！

610794.en: With heaven's mandate, I must get up and keep working. There are ten more mountains to check.
610794.ch: 既有天命在身，我更不便懒散偷闲。快扶我起来，前面还有十座大山尚未勘察。

610796.en: As they argue by the shore, a dark shadow emerges from the river and looks at Yu menacingly.
610796.ch: 岸边，阿禹和族人正在争辩，族人“此次实为侥幸，万望禹公保重身体”，阿禹“自有神明相护，料也无妨”，河水之中突然出现一道黑影，黑影露出两道凶恶的目光暗中窥伺着阿禹。

610797.en: One night, Yu suddenly feels dizzy. Not knowing if he is dreaming, he is swallowed by the water.
610797.ch: 某日深夜，阿禹突然感到一阵天旋地转，也不知自己身处梦境还是现实。再熟悉不过的大水将他全身包围、吞噬。

610798.en: Then a power overcomes him, and he feels the entire world shaking before he falls into an abyss.
610798.ch: 紧接着，一股剧烈的冲击力传遍全身，阿禹在晕眩迷蒙中只觉世界都在震颤，宛入如坠无底深渊。

610799.en: Further away, the moon shines on the cliff. A snake with nine heads in the water looks at the falling Yu, with evil in its red eyes.
610799.ch: 远处，皎洁的月光映照在悬崖绝壁上，一只身体深埋入水、长着九个头颅的怪蛇望着坠落中的阿禹，眼中闪烁着邪魅的红芒。

610800.en: And the statue shatters in your hand.
610800.ch: “啪！”，就在此刻，你手中的玉雕突然碎裂成块。

610801.en: H-How did this happen? The Fox Spirit Orb... shattered!
610801.ch: 啊！这怎么可能，狐灵宝玉它……竟然碎了！

610802.en: Maybe the chief's emotions were too much for the Orb...
610802.ch: 唉，想必是族长情绪变化太过剧烈，致使此宝也无法承受……

610803.ch: 那么，此玉可还有修复之法？

610804.en: Well... yes, but it is against the laws of nature, and therefore very difficult. Someone like you...
610804.ch: 唔……有倒是有，不过碎玉复原有违自然之理，其方法自然困难异常，恐怕你……

610805.en: It is important to your tribe, isn't it? Please, continue.
610805.ch: 此玉既事关重大，长老但说无妨。

610806.en: There are several Tao Realms in Mu Xian, and there is a single point called the Tao Nexus, where they all intersect. If you can obtain a soul of the origin from this location, I can use its powers to reverse the shattering.
610806.ch: 暮仙州境内，有数座道界，然这些道界有一处隐秘的交汇点唤作道界机枢。若你能从道源中收获一枚源魂，我便可以其上的规则之力逆转碎玉。

610807.en: But the Tao Nexus is a treacherous place. It will project someone that you long for, and turn this person into your enemy.
610807.ch: 但是那座道界机枢凶险异常，它会投影出你心中所念之人，与你为敌……

610809.en: Young man, did you manage to get a soul of the origin?
610809.ch: 年轻人，你可有缘取回一枚源魂？

610810.en: Excellent. No wonder you were chosen...
610810.ch: 啊，年轻人你还真是了不起，不愧是被他选中的人……

610812.en: The Grand Elder places the soul of origin on the shattered Orb, and the pieces slowly come together.
610812.ch: 大长老涂山茹将道源凝结于碎玉之上，只见一片片残破的玉碴竟慢慢合并，彼此融合。

610813.en: After about half an hour, a fully repaired statue falls into your hands. You feel dizzy and enter the dream again.
610813.ch: 一炷香后，一个光洁如新的玉雕缓缓落在了你的手上，你陡然晕眩，恍入梦境。

610814.en: Just before Yu smashes into the boulder at the bottom of the abyss, a shadow dashes out from the trees and crashes into Yu, sending him tumbling away from the boulder.
610814.ch: 就在阿禹即将撞上崖底巨石的刹那，一道身影从岸边树丛中闪了出来，它狠狠撞向阿禹，使其堪堪免于被岩石断为两截的下场。

610815.en: Yu comes to and struggles to get up. He sees a pool of blood in the water.
610815.ch: 阿禹被撞到了岸边，他挣扎着坐起身，意识逐渐清醒。此刻，一缕血迹顺着河水流到了阿禹眼前的水中。

610816.en: He looks up and sees a white fox on a rock, bleeding from a would so deep that he can see the bones. It is about to die.
610816.ch: 阿禹定睛看去，只见崖底岩石上，一只白狐正趴在其上，它的身躯被岩石划开了一道深可见骨的伤痕，血流不止，眼看其生命力就将流逝殆尽。

610817.en: Yu checks the fox's wounds. It turns to look at him and morphs into half-fox, half-human, then speaks up.
610817.ch: 阿禹赶忙上前查看白狐伤势，就在这时，这只白狐竟然艰难地转头看向阿禹，身体竟悄然变化为半人半狐的样子，张嘴口吐人言。

610819.en: You... you know who I am?

610820.en: I was compelled by the heavenly path...

610821.en: You're hurt! Stop talking, I'll take you to get help.
610821.ch: 你伤势极重，快别说话了，我这就带你找医生去！

610822.en: I shall sacrifice myself to keep you safe, so you may alleviate the flood and return peace to the world...
610822.ch: 自当舍身护你周全，使洪水早日退散，还八荒众生安宁……

610825.ch: 可如今小女子性命垂危……

610828.en: Yu looks back and sees the cliff. He looks up and hears faint voices of his people above the cliff.
610828.ch: 闻听此言，阿禹回头望去，只见身后竟是一处万丈悬崖，悬崖上方似乎还能零星看到一些族人在向下探身呐喊。

610829.en: Could it be that... you were watching over me all these years?
610829.ch: 莫非，这数十年里我屡次死里逃生，都是阁下所救……

610830.en: I thought it was a sign from above, but it was all you...
610830.ch: 我还只道是天命有常，原来竟是一只妖兽的因果……

610831.en: I must repay you, little fox. Please tell me how! I will even give my life for you, if I could overcome the flood.
610831.ch: 知恩不报枉为人矣。小白狐，要我如何相救，你尽管言说！若水患平定，便是搭上我的性命也无妨。

610833.ch: 若要救我倒也不难……只是……

610834.ch: 你性命垂危，速将施救之法告知于我，千万别耽误了！

610835.en: Right... Just promise me one thing so that I may take shape, and I will live...
610835.ch: 唔……如此，你只需答应我一句话，让我讨封化形，我便可活命……

610836.ch: 好好好！要答应什么你快说！

610837.en: Will you... take me as your wife?

610838.en: Yu is shocked to hear this and nearly turned to stone. He never once thought about marriage, and he's been focusing on the flood since he was nearly killed by the Blood Lord on that day.
610838.ch: 听闻此语，阿禹心头剧震、宛如石化。他数十年未曾考虑婚配之事，自从那日被血魔斩杀后重塑肉身，他便一直专心治水。

610839.en: He thinks of the beautiful Jagu. However, the fox saved his life numerous times, and is about to die because of him. He feels helpless, not knowing what to do.
610839.ch: 如今被问及情爱之事，武罗的倩影不禁浮上心头，可眼前狐妖无数次救了自己性命，眼下又要因自己而死，阿禹不禁心下焦急，不知如何是好。

610841.en: Something shrieks in the sky, then a storm descends upon them. A fiend circles about them, carefully choosing its next target.
610841.ch: 一道狂暴的雕唳在天空炸响，突然间，天空风雷大作，紧接着暴雨倾盆而下，一只凶恶的雕兽盘旋在半空，它正打量着山中的众人，似乎在挑选着猎杀目标。

610844.en: Stop asking questions and come with me!
610844.ch: 小辈休要多言，快随我等进山躲避！

610846.en: The fiend swoops down and picks up Yao, then flies off.
610846.ch: 那妖兽俯冲下来，一把抓起涂山谣，就要往远方飞去。

610847.en: The fiend, with Yao in its claws, flies toward the far end of the tundra.
610847.ch: 蛊雕带着涂山谣离开涂山，向着冰原深处飞去了。

610849.en: ...We just lost another young one. If we don't kill it, the Nine Tails will be extinct in a few months.
610849.ch: ……我族又少一位后辈。此雕不除，不消几月，八荒便无我九尾狐一族的容身之地了……

610850.en: Wait, really? The fiend is very powerful, and no one in our tribe is powerful enough to fight it.
610850.ch: 此话当真？那蛊雕实力深不可测，自族长殒命后，我族中再无可与之匹敌的人……

610852.ch: 那，阿谣的性命可就全都拜托你了！

610853.en: You... What... are you doing here?

610854.en: I'm here to bring you back to Tushan. It's too dangerous out here.
610854.ch: 此地危险，不宜久留，且与我速返涂山。

610856.en: The fiend is very powerful, and no one in our tribe is powerful enough to fight it.
610856.ch: 这蛊雕实力深不可测，自族长殒命后，我族中再无可与之匹敌的人……

610857.en: Our numbers have dwindled and there's nothing I can do...
610857.ch: 如今族人凋落，老朽也无力回天……

610858.en: Young man, let me take back the statue for now so I can pray for Yao. It's getting late, you should leave.
610858.ch: 年轻人，此玉雕且容我收回，我当作法与谣儿祈福……时候不早，你还是请回吧。

610859.en: Yao and the Grand Elder hold each other tight as they cry.
610859.ch: 劫后余生的涂山谣和大长老涂山茹紧紧相拥，二者泣不成声。

610861.en: The ancestors are watching over you, my child. You were not meant to die.
610861.ch: 哎，好孩子，有族长大人护佑，你这是命不该绝呀！

610863.en: The jade statue suddenly glows brightly. The iron ingot, as if guided by something, touches the statue. You feel dizzy again.
610863.ch: 此时，空中那块玉雕却突然光芒大方，铁尺似是受到指引，轻轻触碰在其上，二者相击发出清脆嗡鸣，你一下感到神智迷离。

610864.en: Yu looks at the fox in his arms, a thousand thoughts racing through his mind.
610864.ch: 阿禹怔怔地看着怀中白狐，一时间思绪万千。

610869.en: Yu's thoughts go back twenty years, he saw Jagu telling him to leave.
610869.ch: 恍惚间，阿禹的思绪飘飞回到二十年前，他仿佛又看到小武罗苦口婆心劝自己离开的样子……

610870.ch: 阿禹，你快出去看呐，山上突然来了好多人！

610872.en: They're your people. Don't you want to go back to them?
610872.ch: 他们可都是你的同胞，难道你不想回到你们人类居住的地方生活？

610874.en: You... you said you wanted to live in the mountains with me.
610874.ch: 你……你说想和我一直住在山里……

610875.en: But... many have already died in this flood. If only I were powerful enough to fight this flood...
610875.ch: 但是……这漫天洪水使八荒生灵涂炭，要不是我修为尚浅，必然要以命相搏遏制水患。

610877.en: Alright, I promise you. If you can overcome the flood, I will stay with you in the mountains.
610877.ch: 行，我答应你，如果你能平定此处水患，我便与你在山上久居。

610878.en: Now, come with me to reunite with your people!
610878.ch: 好了，快随我出去与你族人相见吧！

610880.en: It's alright... I'm just a fiend, and... Definitely not a proper wife for you...
610880.ch: 也罢……小女子本乃一介妖物……咳咳……又何尝堪配阁下……

610881.en: I saved you all those times because... I... wanted to... I hope you don't feel guilty about my death.
610881.ch: 我屡次施救绝无私心……我之一死，还望您莫要心生歉意……

610882.en: Tu Shanjun's blood stops flowing and her body starts to shatter.
610882.ch: 涂山珺说着话，血液逐渐流干，其身躯伴随妖力的消逝而逐渐破碎，仿佛瞬息间就将魂飞魄散。

610883.en: I... I will take you as my wife!

610886.en: Upon hearing these words, Tu Shanjun suddenly opens her eyes, which glow gold. Her wounds close up immediately as she transforms into a beautiful woman with long black hair.
610886.ch: 阿禹这一言之下，涂山珺忽然睁开双眸，其中金光大放，她浑身的伤势竟然迅速自发愈合。长发飘散间，她竟缓缓化作了一位美貌绝伦的人形女子。

610887.en: After her transformation is complete, Tu Shanjun bows down to Yu, who helps her up immediately. Again, a thousand things race through Yu's mind, but he's certain that she would have died if he hesitated a moment longer.
610887.ch: 化形完成后，涂山珺对着阿禹款款下拜，阿禹赶忙把她扶起。此刻，阿禹心头是一团乱麻，刚才若再迟疑一瞬，这狐妖便已然命丧当场。

610889.en: The light from the statue fades, and Tu Shanjun's spirit becomes a breeze before returning to the mountains.
610889.ch: 玉雕中的光芒逐渐散去，涂山珺的妖灵也化作一阵清风，返回了后山。

610890.en: Young man, you looked tired from your... ordeal. My chief asked me to give this statue to you, so you may study it later.
610890.ch: 年轻人，看你晕乎半晌，想必是累了。族长大人命我将此玉雕赠予阁下，日后你自可仔细赏玩。

610891.en: Your trip has pleased the chief, but it's getting late and I must leave. May our paths cross again.
610891.ch: 嗯，你此行似乎也让族长大人欢欣不已。时候不早，我们有缘再会。

610892.en: I also have no idea, and can only wait for something to happen. It's getting late, young man. May our paths cross again.
610892.ch: 此事我等亦无从知晓，只能静候机缘罢了。时候不早，我们有缘再会。

610893.en: Did you learn something from the statue?
610893.ch: 嗯？你是否从那玉雕中获知了什么？

610894.en: Never mind. If the chief didn't say anything, then it's better that we don't know. It's getting late, young man. May our paths cross again.
610894.ch: 罢了，倘若族长大人不愿向我等言明，我等不知也罢。时候不早，我们有缘再会。

610895.en: You get ready to leave Tushan and see a girl sleeping on the grass. You realize that you've been so busy, you completely forgot about her.
610895.ch: 你正准备离开涂山，却发现山口草垛中躺着一个女孩，没想到自己忙活半天，竟然把她忘了……

610897.en: Did I sleep for a long time? Hm?

610898.en: Oh, the iron ingot finally stopped flying. Did I miss something?
610898.ch: 诶？这铁块终于消停了？难道我错过了什么事情？

610899.en: This is the land of the untamed. Let me take you back.
610899.ch: 此乃妖族之地，我还是送你回去吧。

610900.en: Don't treat me like a child! If the ingot is playing dead, I'll take it back myself.
610900.ch: 我可不是小孩子了，才不要你送！它既然又装死了，我自己带它回去就好。

610901.en: Don't be a stranger! Come visit me in Yukong Village when you have time.
610901.ch: 有机会常来愚村找我玩啊！

610903.en: The Tao Nexus is overflowing with evil. Enter anyway?
610903.ch: 道界机枢之中妖力浓郁，是否要进入其中？

610904.en: The eagle is still circling above. Fight it?
610904.ch: 蛊雕尚未离去，是否要与之战斗？

610905.en: This is the eagle's nest. Go inside?
610905.ch: 此处便是蛊雕的巢穴了，是否要进入其中？

610906.en: The eagle is still in its nest. Fight it?
610906.ch: 蛊雕仍在巢中，是否要与之战斗？

610908.en: This place is full of evil. Explore it?
610908.ch: 此处妖气浓郁，是否进入一探？

610909.en: Tu Shanhao realizes the situation has changed. He immediately transforms and leaves.
610909.ch: 见势不妙，涂山皓变幻身形，瞬息间已然溜走了。

610913.en: I have been trying to ambush this fiend for a long time. You can't take my prey!
610913.ch: 我埋伏此妖已久，你怎可突然出手抢夺我的猎物？

610914.en: I will only say this once. Leave all the valuables behind!
610914.ch: 我只说一遍，把宝贝都给我交出来！

610916.en: You're a smart one. I'll let you off the hook today. Now get lost!
610916.ch: 不错，挺上道啊！今日便放你一马，滚吧！

610917.en: Is that all you got? Are you playing me for a fool? I'll kill you!
610917.ch: 这等货色也好意思拿出来丢人现眼？莫非是在羞辱于我？！今日你死定了！

610921.en: You're in a rush to go somewhere, but you're also extremely tired, so you decide to take a nap by the road.
610921.ch: 这日，你正匆匆赶路，突然一阵困意上涌。你一时难抵睡魔侵袭，就在路旁趁荫而憩。

610922.en: As you fall asleep, you find yourself in a dream, surrounded by ethereal clouds and foxes. You find it incredible.
610922.ch: 不久你便沉沉睡去。梦中，你只觉四下云雾缭绕、仙气氤氲。周围有无数仙狐萦绕，你心中倍感奇特。

610923.en: Suddenly, a mouth opens in front of you. You see a flaming beast charging at you. The sky feels like it's on fire as everything around you burns.
610923.ch: 突然，一张血盆大口出现在你面前，只见一头凶兽浑身散发烈焰，正朝你猛扑而来。天空似乎都被点燃，瞬息间宛若火烧。

610924.en: You are unable to move, and can only watch yourself be incinerated by the flame. Your body turns into ash that scatters in the wind.
610924.ch: 你全身紧绷，无法动弹，只能眼睁睁看着火焰将全身吞噬。燃烧着的体表一点点化作灰烬，继而随风飘散。

610925.en: Your mind doesn't fade, however. It grows heavier and you feel yourself falling through the clouds, into the abyss.
610925.ch: 然而，你的意识非但没有消失，反而变得愈加沉重、仿有千斤。你感觉自己跌落云雾，如坠万丈深渊。

610926.en: You feel something in your chest, and find yourself in a dark place. You are also surrounded by foxes here. In fact, they're the same foxes as before.
610926.ch: 随着胸口传来一声闷响，你发现自己身处一个幽暗之地，可就在此处，四周竟也有不少狐狸，它们与之前所见一般无二，煞是诡异。

610927.en: "Are you alright?" A voice echoes through your mind. Then a lonely figure appears in your consciousness.
610927.ch: “你还好吗？”你的脑海中响起一个声音，随后，一道孤寂的倩影出现在你的意识之中。

610928.en: "You..." You try to walk forward to touch the figure, but it disappears immediately.
610928.ch: “你……”你下意识地想催动身体往前走，想伸手触碰那道背影，可却宛如一脚踩空，那背影消失无踪。

610929.en: Then you find yourself suddenly surrounded by countless monsters. They clap to welcome you.
610929.ch: 就在这时，你周围突然出现无数鬼怪，他们将你团团围住，拍手相迎。

610930.en: "Ahhhh!" You scream and wake up. There's something heavy in your hands, and you see that you're holding a gemstone.
610930.ch: “啊！”随着一声惊呼，你醒了过来。你发现手中沉甸甸的，低头一看，竟发现手里正捧着一块玉石。

611001.en: {call|B|A}, in order to complete our mission as soon as we can, one of us should go inside to collect resources and the other one should keep watch. What do you think is the next step?
611001.ch: {call|B|A}，为了尽快完成任务，此刻应由一人进入其中收集资源，而另一人负责望风把守。依你之见，接下来我们该如何行事？

611101.en: Very well. Please collect the resources, {call|B|A}.
611101.ch: 好，那么便有劳{call|B|A}收集资源了。

611201.en: Very well. I'll leave you to keep watch, {call|B|A}. I'll collect the resources.
611201.ch: 好，望风一事便交由{call|B|A}了，我去收集资源。

611401.en: {call|B|A}, these resources should be enough. Let's get outta here!
611401.ch: {call|B|A}，这些资源应该足以让我们回去复命了！快离开此地吧！

611501.en: In that case, you and I shall move as one today!
611501.ch: 既然如此，今日我便与你同进同退！

611801.ch: （这些资源应该足以让我们回去复命了，接下来怎么办？）

611901.en: That's enough. The Interspatial Ring can't hold any more resources. Time to go!
611901.ch: 足够了，储物戒恐怕已无法容纳更多的资源！快走吧！

612001.en: (The Interspatial Ring can't hold any more resources. Time to go!)
612001.ch: （储物戒已无法容纳更多的资源了，这便离开吧！）

612101.en: That was smooth. Let's head back to the Sect, yeah?
612101.ch: 此行还算顺利，我们这便回宗门吧？

612201.en: In that case, I'll report back to the Sect now. Take care, {call|B|A}!
612201.ch: 既如此，我便回宗门复命了。{call|B|A}，保重！

612301.en: Scoundrels! How dare you steal the resources of my Sect?
612301.ch: 哪里来的毛贼？！竟然敢窃取我宗的资源！

612501.en: {call|B|A}, if you're ready, let's head to {eventName} together, yeah?
612501.ch: {call|B|A}，若是准备好了，我们便一同前往{eventName}吧？

612601.en: In that case, I'll scout out {eventName} first. Once you're ready, find me at {eventName}.
612601.ch: 既如此，我便先行前去{eventName}查探一番。待你准备好后，来{eventName}附近寻我便可。

612701.en: You're finally here, {call|B|A}! Let's enter {eventName} now.
612701.ch: {call|B|A}，你可算来了…我们这便进入{eventName}吧？

612801.en: Hmph, really were you guys.... Mindsnap Temple....

612802.en: Oh what is it, is this part of the world controlled by the Taoist Mind Pavilion, and we're not allowed to be here?
612802.ch: 呵呵，怎样，难道这八荒山海是你家道心阁开的，还不许我等在此？

612803.ch: 一群乌合之众，竟还如此不知羞耻！

612804.en: Bullshit, you filthy animals that only know how to hide. There must be something happening behind the scenes!
612804.ch: 放屁，尔等衣冠禽兽，藏藏掖掖，背后必有所图！

612805.en: Cut the crap, since you met me. Today's the day you will die!
612805.ch: 少废话，既是遇到在下，今日便是你的死期！

612806.en: Hahaha, I return your words back to you!

612807.en: (This is none of my business, it's best to leave here as soon as possible.)
612807.ch: （此事与我无关，还是尽快离开此地为妙。）

612808.en: Just you wait, the Taoist Mind Pavilion will not let it go at that!
612808.ch: 你们给我等着，道心阁绝不会善罢甘休！

612809.en: Thank you! This is a token of my organization, and I gift it to you in token of appreciation for your kindness!
612809.ch: 多谢！此物乃我组织信物，今日赠予阁下，以谢阁下仗义出手！

612810.en: Just you wait, the Mindsnap Temple will not let it go at that!
612810.ch: 你们给我等着，蚀心殿绝不会善罢甘休！

612813.en: Hmph, so it's your reinforcements, the Taoist Mind Pavilion is really despicable! Take this!
612813.ch: 哼，原来是你的援军，道心阁果然卑鄙！接招！

612815.en: Hmph, so it's your reinforcements, the Mindsnap Temple is really despicable! Take this!
612815.ch: 哼，原来是你的援军，蚀心殿果然卑鄙！接招！

612816.ch: 哈哈哈哈，妖道，你也有今天！

612817.en: Falling into our hands, you know what will happen to you right?
612817.ch: 落入我们的手里，你大概也知道自己的下场如何吧？

612818.en: Save us the trouble, hand over the Taoist Mind and perhaps we can spare your life.
612818.ch: 若是把道心交出来，免得我们费事，哥几个还可能饶你一命。

612819.en: Kill me, cut me or do whatever you want. I am at your mercy.

612821.en: Hmph, no wonder you remained so calm even in the face to death. Turns out the Taoist Mind Pavilion has set up an ambush here.
612821.ch: 哼，难怪你死到临头还这般淡定，原来是道心阁有伏兵在此。

612822.en: Did you think you could rely on this person to save you? Dream on!
612822.ch: 不过，凭借此人就想将你救出？做梦！

612823.en: Damn it, this person is very powerful, it's best we retreat first.
612823.ch: 可恶，此人好生厉害，我等还是先撤为妙！

612824.en: Words cannot express my gratitude for your saving me. The Taoist Mind Pavilion will definitely repay this favor! This jade token is from our organization. Please take it, and I hope we meet again!
612824.ch: 大恩不言谢，道友救命之恩，我道心阁必有报答！这块玉牌乃我阁信物，阁下权且收好，日后有缘必会再见！

612825.en: Oh? Could it be that you also hate the people of the Taoist Mind Pavilion to the core and want to get rid of them?
612825.ch: 哦？莫非道友也对道心阁之人恨之入骨，欲除之而后快？

612826.en: Haha, look at the sins you have created. The Mindsnap Temple's destruction of the Taoist Mind Pavilion truly is in line with the heavens, and we exact the justice of the heavens.
612826.ch: 哈哈，看看你等造下的孽，我蚀心殿剿灭道心阁实乃顺天应人、替天行道啊。

612827.en: Well then, this person will be handed to you. I await the time to suppress the formation for you.
612827.ch: 那么，此人便交给阁下了，我等为你压阵。

612828.en: Cut the bullshit, even if I die here today, I will remove the scourge of the world. Take this!
612828.ch: 废话少说，纵使今日在下战死此地，也要为八荒清除祸患，接招！

612829.en: Your cultivation is not bad, not bad at all! Go on, kill {gender2|B}!
612829.ch: 阁下确有几分道行，那么就快快动手，杀了{gender|B}！

612830.en: Damn you! I left this man for your disposal but you dare let {gender2|B} escape?
612830.ch: 可恨！我将此人交由你处置，你竟敢放任{gender|B}逃离！

612831.en: If that's the case, then I can't keep you today!
612831.ch: 既然如此，今日我留你不得！

612832.en: Hmph, today's incident will be remembered by the Mindsnap Temple! Next time we meet, I'll definitely take your life!
612832.ch: 哼…今日之事，我蚀心殿记下了！他日再会，我定会取你性命！

612833.en: Hmph, today's incident will be remembered by the Mindsnap Temple!
612833.ch: 哼…今日之事，我蚀心殿记下了！

612835.en: Since the matter has been cleared up, we shouldn't stay here for too long. We shall meet again if fate permits. Take this lacquered plaque, a token of the Mindsnap Temple. You can figure out its uses on your own.
612835.ch: 此事既已了结，我等不便在此地久留，他日有缘再会。这漆牌你且收下，乃我蚀心殿信物，其中妙用你可自行参悟。

612836.en: You've been heavily poisoned, just give up! You're not going to escape no matter what today!
612836.ch: 你中毒已深，放弃吧！无论如何，你今日都难逃一死！

612837.en: You... you people of the Mindsnap Temple are truly despicable!
612837.ch: 你们…你们蚀心殿之人果真是卑鄙无耻！

612838.en: Where did this nosy guy come from? Hmph, it doesn't matter how hard you try, this person's not going to live long so you might as well wait and collect the corpse for {gender2|B}.
612838.ch: 哪来的家伙？！真是多管闲事！哼，但无论你再怎么努力，此人也活不长了，等着替{gender|B}收尸吧！

612839.en: (Looks like we have to take care of these guys in front of us before the poison kicks in!)
612839.ch: （看来必须要在毒性发作之前，解决眼前这些家伙！）

612840.en: Looks like you have some skills boy! But don't get too happy yet, the Mindsnap Temple will not let you go easily!
612840.ch: 好小子，有两下子！别高兴得太早，蚀心殿一定不会轻易放过你的！

612843.en: My mission's already complete, so I won't be accompanying you. Remember this, the Mindsnap Temple will not let you go!
612843.ch: 我的任务已经完成，便不奉陪了！你给我记住了，蚀心殿一定不会放过你的！

612844.en: Taoist Mind Pavilion scum, you will not escape today!
612844.ch: 道心阁的鼠辈，今日你在劫难逃！

612845.en: Villains of the Mindsnap Temple, I'll kill you!
612845.ch: 蚀心殿的恶徒，我跟你们拼了！

612846.en: Meddlesome fool! I'll kill you first!
612846.ch: 多管闲事的家伙！哼，我先杀了你！

612849.en: Oh? Could it be that you have deep contempt for this person? How interesting...
612849.ch: 哦？莫非你与此人有深仇大恨？有意思…

612850.en: In that case, out of my respect for you, I will let you decide what to do with this person's life.
612850.ch: 既然如此，我便卖道友一个面子，此人的性命便由道友来做个了断吧！

612851.en: Damned bastard, even if I die today, I will never let you go!
612851.ch: 可恶的家伙，我今日即便是死，也绝不会放过你！

612852.en: Not bad, not bad at all! Go on, kill {gender2|B}!
612852.ch: 不错，实力尚可！动手，杀了{gender|B}！

612853.en: Damn you! I left this man for your disposal but you dare let {gender2|B} escape? How dare you trick us? Die!
612853.ch: 可恨！我将此人交由你处置，你竟敢放任{gender|B}逃离！竟然耍我们！受死！

612858.en: Since the matter has been concluded, we shouldn't stay here for too long. We shall meet again if fate permits.
612858.ch: 此事既已了结，我等不便在此地久留，他日有缘再会。

612859.en: Look closely, {name|A}! your {relation|B|A} {name|B} is in my hands!
612859.ch: {name|A}，你可看清楚了！你的{relation|B|A}{name|B}在我的手中！

612861.en: {name|B} is the enemy of the Mindsnap Temple. I will use whatever means necessary to kill {gender2|B}!
612861.ch: {name|B}是我蚀心殿的敌人，为了杀死{gender|B}，我可以不择手段！

612862.en: If you are willing to hand over this person, I will spare your {relation|B|A} {name|B}. I hope you don't make a foolish choice.
612862.ch: 你若是愿意将此人交出来，我便饶了你的{relation|B|A}{name|B}，希望你不要不识好歹！

612863.en: The moon is bright and the stars are few in this desolate area. Two black-robed persons are facing each other, the atmosphere grows tense.
612863.ch: 月明星稀，荒郊野外，两个黑袍人彼此对立，场面剑拔弩张。

612864.en: The moon is bright and the stars are few in this desolate area. Several black-robed persons are surrounding another black-robed person tightly.
612864.ch: 月明星稀，荒郊野外，几个黑袍人正把另一个黑袍人堵在当中。

612866.en: {call|B|A}, I received the order to assassinate you after you found out my identity that day. Perhaps {heresyName|B} has seen you as a threat to the organization...
612866.ch: {call|B|A}，自从那日你发现了我的身份后，我收到了暗杀你的任务，恐怕{heresyName|B}认为你的行为对组织造成了威胁…

612867.en: But you are my {relation|A|B}, and I can't do it...
612867.ch: 可你是我的{relation|A|B}，我无法对你下手…

612868.en: Whoever gave the order is in a high position in the {heresyName|B}, and I've never seen him in person...
612868.ch: 那人在{heresyName|B}中地位极高，我也未曾见过其面目…

612869.en: He has never shown his strength, but there is no doubt of his superiority in cultivation.
612869.ch: 虽然他从未出过手，但他的实力绝对不容小窥。

612870.en: I usually meet with him near {mapData106} after completing a mission... If everything goes as I expect, he will appear near {mapData106} in 3 months. If you want to meet him, I'll go with you.
612870.ch: 我完成了任务后，通常会在{mapData106}附近与他碰面…若我猜的不错，3个月内他应该会在{mapData106}附近出现。你若是想与他会面，我便与你一同前往吧。

612871.en: I usually meet with him near {mapData108} after completing a mission... If everything goes as I expect, he will appear near {mapData106} in 3 months. If you want to meet him, I'll go with you.
612871.ch: 我完成了任务后，通常会在{mapData108}附近与他碰面…若我猜的不错，3个月内他应该会在{mapData106}附近出现。你若是想与他会面，我便与你一同前往吧。

612872.en: Perhaps more {heresyName|B} will come at you in the future. Please take care.
612872.ch: 日后，恐怕会有更多的{heresyName|B}前来寻你，请多加小心。

612873.en: You're here... But that person hasn't arrived yet. Just wait a little longer.
612873.ch: 你来了…但那人似乎还没来，再等一等吧。

612875.en: You're here... That person is just over there. Shall we go now?
612875.ch: 你来了…那人就在前方不远，我们现在就过去吗？

612876.en: (There is someone over there. Shall we go now?)
612876.ch: （前方不远处似乎有个人，要过去看看吗？）

612879.en: Hmph! You did betray the {heresyName|B}! Now you're here, you must have thought it through. Die!
612879.ch: 哼！不出所料，你果然背叛了{heresyName|B}！既然你们敢来到此地，想必已做好了赴死的觉悟，接招吧！

612881.en: None of you will escape! Arrgh... Damn it!
612881.ch: 一个也别想逃！唔…可恶的家伙！

612883.en: {call|B|A}, thank you! Now this person is dead, no one in the {heresyName|B} knows my identity anymore. From today on, I have nothing to do with the {heresyName|B}.
612883.ch: {call|B|A}，谢谢你！既然此人已死，{heresyName|B}中已无人知晓我的身份了。从此以后，我与{heresyName|B}再无瓜葛。

612885.en: Hahaha! That guy did betray the {heresyName|B}, just as I expected! I'll catch you and make you pay!
612885.ch: 哈哈哈！不出所料，那个家伙果然背叛了{heresyName|B}！待我将你拿下，再好好的算一算这笔账！

612887.en: For years, I dedicated myself to the Righteous path, enduring humiliation and training vigorously... But no matter how hard I worked, no one ever showed me respect...
612887.ch: 这么多年来， 我心向正道、忍辱负重，刻苦修行…但无论我如何努力，却始终没人瞧得起我…

720101.en: When we had that fight back then, I never thought you would one day become {appellation|A}.
720101.ch: 先前与你有些恩怨，是我有眼无珠，但未想到你竟能成为{appellation|A}。

720102.en: Please accept this as my apology and forgive my offense to you.
720102.ch: 这些仅是鄙人的一点小心意，还期望你大人不计小人过，不要因为过去的嫌隙与鄙人计较。

720103.en: {appellation|A}, you have such a broad mind.

720104.en: Such a petty mind for a {appellation|A}.

720109.en: We {school|B} will be very happy to have a {appellation|A} like you in our Sect.
720109.ch: 道友如今获得如此成就，我{school|B}非常期望你这{appellation|A}的加入。

720110.en: Please accept this little gift. Even if you don't want to join our Sect, I still want to be your friend.
720110.ch: 这些是在下的一些小心意，若你不愿入我宗，也希望能与你有个交情。

720111.en: Sure! You are a worthy friend!
720111.ch: 好！你这个朋友我交定了。

720112.en: That's fine. We {school|B} will always welcome you if you change your mind one day.
720112.ch: 无碍无碍，我{school|B}会永远欢迎你的加入。

720117.en: You already have so many beautiful women. Why did you still become Partner with my wife?
720117.ch: 阁下坐拥众多美人，为何还要与我的妻子结为道侣。

720118.en: I know my wife won't give up on a {appellation|A} like you. Please accept this little gift and stop being a Partner with my wife.
720118.ch: 我知道你乃{appellation|A}，我的妻子不会主动放弃你。这些是我的一些小心意，在下恳请你解除与我的妻子的道侣关系。

720120.en: Why did you snatch my spouse?

720121.en: You already have so many handsome men. Why did you still become Partner with my husband?
720121.ch: 阁下坐拥众多美男，为何还要与我的丈夫结为道侣。

720122.en: I know my husband won't give up on a {appellation|A} like you. Please accept this little gift and stop being a Partner with my husband.
720122.ch: 我知道你乃{appellation|A}，我的丈夫不会舍弃对你的爱。这些是我的一些小心意，在下恳请你解除与我丈夫的道侣关系。

720125.en: I appreciate your generosity, {appellation|A}. I hope you will like this little gift.
720125.ch: 在下十分欣赏你这{appellation|A}的大气。送你一些小物件，希望你喜欢。

720126.en: I hope we can see each other more often.
720126.ch: 日后期望能与你多多往来。

720127.en: Please forgive my mistake. I should have realized a {appellation|A} like you has no use for such a petty thing.
720127.ch: 怪我愚钝，堂堂{appellation|A}定不会缺我这点东西。

720128.en: {appellation|A}, I've always been admiring you since I heard about your achievements. Please accept this little gift.
720128.ch: {appellation|A}，在下听闻了你的事迹，十分仰慕你。此物乃我一点心意。

720131.en: You are the pride of us Rogue Cultivators! Please accept this little gift, {appellation|A}.
720131.ch: 阁下乃散修们的骄傲！此物乃我对于你{appellation|A}的小小敬意。

720134.en: I thought my alchemy skill was pretty good, but I never imagined that your alchemy skills were that incredible! Here's a small gift from me, hopefully it will be of use to you.
720134.ch: 在下本觉得自己炼丹资质尚且不错，想不到您这{appellation|A}的炼丹术简直出神入化！送你些小物件，不知你可否需要？

720135.en: You can always exchange alchemy knowledge with me in the future.
720135.ch: 以后可常与我交流炼丹心得。

720136.en: I look forward to discussing alchemy with you in the future.
720136.ch: 期望日后能与你探讨炼丹之术。

720137.en: I have heard about your achievements, {appellation|A}. I'd like to give you something as a token of my appreciation, perhaps it may be of use to you.
720137.ch: 关于您这{appellation|A}的事迹，在下有所耳闻。想赠您些东西以表钦佩之意，不知您可否需要？

720138.en: I am very much looking forward to getting along with you.
720138.ch: 在下十分期望与你交好。

720139.en: It is my honor today to be able to talk to you{appellation|A}.
720139.ch: 今日能与{appellation|A}交谈，真是我的荣幸。

900005.en: Hold on. Victory is just around the corner.

900011.en: Hah! So you do know what's good for you!

900012.en: You don't know what's good for you. I'll show you!
900012.ch: 不识好歹，今日便让我好好教训你！

900014.en: That would be nice, thank you Cultivator.

900015.en: In that case, may the best man win!
900015.ch: 既然如此，便各凭本事吧！

900016.en: Thank you! I am forever indebted to you!
900016.ch: 多谢！今日之恩，我将永远铭记于心。

900017.en: I never thought you would betray me!

900018.ch: 这个{1}看起来不错，我出价{0}灵石！

900020.en: Cultivator, I really need that {1}. Please let me have it.

900021.en: You think you can intimidate me?! I bid {0}! C'mon! Keep bidding!

900022.en: Since there are no bidders, the {1} can go in my bag.
900022.ch: 既然没人出价，那么这{1}我便收入囊中了。

900024.en: Sorry, but I really need that {1}. I won't give it up easily.
900024.ch: 抱歉，这{1}对我有大用，我不能拱手相让。

900026.ch: 我不让给你又如何？！你若真想要{1}，便继续出价吧！

900027.en: Can I have the {1}? I'll give you this {2} as compensation.
900027.ch: 能否将{1}让给我？作为补偿，这{2}便送给你了。

900028.en: You will let me have the {1}, if you know what's good for you.
900028.ch: 你若有自知之明，就不要和我争夺{1}。

900101.en: I can't believe you! Fine... You can have the {1}.
900101.ch: 没想到你竟是这种人！好…这{1}我让给你便是。

900201.en: I am too weak. You can have the {1}... but I won't forget what happened here today!
900201.ch: 既然我实力低下，那么这{1}让给你便是…但我绝不会忘乐今日之辱！

900301.en: You are full of surprises... Very well, you can have the {1}.
900301.ch: 想不到你竟有这等背景…这{1}我不与你争便是。

900401.en: Give up the {1}? Who do you think you are?!
900401.ch: 想让我让出{1}？你算什么玩意？！

900501.en: Fine... I'll let you have the {1}, for old times' sake.
900501.ch: 好吧…看在往日交情的份上，这{1}便让给你了。

900601.en: Why is no one bidding? You paupers!
900601.ch: 怎么没人出价了？一群穷鬼！

901101.en: Getting your butt kicked is character building!

901301.en: You are an exceptional talent. I would like to take you on as my Disciple. You have the potential to be a great Cultivator! What do you say?
901301.ch: 你天赋甚佳，我有意将你收为弟子，倾尽全力将你培养成一方强者！不知你意下如何？

901401.en: Wonderful! From this day on you shall be my Disciple.
901401.ch: 如此甚好！今日起，你便是我{name|B}的弟子了。

910002.en: You really know what you're doing!

910003.en: You are the mightiest warrior of your age!
910003.ch: 如此威能，足让同辈汗颜！

910004.ch: 这一式，莫非是传说中的……

910006.en: There is no limit to what you can achieve!

910012.ch: 同辈之中，难寻出其右者矣。

910016.en: An accomplished and sophisticated cultivator, a worthy friend!
910016.ch: 修为不俗、道法精妙，值得一交。

910017.en: Watching them fight makes my fingers itch.
910017.ch: 观此人比斗，在下竟也技痒难耐。

910019.ch: 哈哈哈，敌对之人可有罪受了。

910021.ch: 不曾想竟在此地得以一饱眼福。

914003.en: Hang in there. He is almost done.

916001.en: Your Tao is formidable. I would like to take you on as my Disciple and help you along the Path to Immortality. Well? What do you think?
916001.ch: 小友道法了得，倒是个难遇的好苗子，今我欲收你为徒，也好在求仙之路上点拨于你，你可愿意？

916002.en: You are very accomplished for one so young. With my counsel you will go far.
916002.ch: 如此年纪便有这般修为实属不易，若能得到我的指教，你必定前途无量！

916003.en: I am known throughout the land. If you become my Disciple, you will have to travel far and wide.
916003.ch: 这八荒界谁不知晓我的名号，你若拜我为师，八荒之大任你遨游。

918001.en: Yes! Once you join me, our fortunes will be bound together.
918001.ch: 痛快！入了为师门下，日后少不了你的造化。

918002.en: Good! Hereafter you can wander the land. I will be your rock and benefactor.
918002.ch: 好！以后行走八荒，为师就是你的靠山。

918003.en: As I thought, my Disciple has a keen eye. Hahaha!
918003.ch: 如我所料，爱徒果然慧眼，哈哈哈！

918004.en: From this day forth, if you encounter an enemy, be sure to declare yourself as my Disciple, then teach them a lesson they won't soon forget!
918004.ch: 从今日起，遇到仇人尽管报上为师名号，管教敌人倒戈卸甲、不战自退!

919001.en: Leave now and I'll pretend I didn't see you. Don't say I never did anything for you!
919001.ch: 赶紧弃权退出，我权当没见过你，你可不要不识抬举！

919002.en: You're no match for me. Leave now and save some dignity. You can thank me later!
919002.ch: 阁下非我一合之敌，趁早弃权也能保全脸面，可莫要不领情！

919003.en: A friendly reminder—you might want to think about who I am and where I come from before you attack me.
919003.ch: 哼哼，友情提醒，你先看清楚在下乃何许人也，再考虑清楚是否要动手！

920001.en: You should have stayed in bed today.

920002.en: Intelligence is choosing the right course of action. See yourself out!
920002.ch: 识时务者为俊杰，慢走不送！

920003.en: Prudence is the better part of valor.

921001.en: Wrong decision, and I will prove it.
921001.ch: 我将证明这是一个错误的决定。

921002.en: As you'd rather do it the hard way, I will comply!
921002.ch: 既然你非要敬酒不吃吃罚酒，那我便成全你！

921003.en: There is no remedy for regret. Expect no mercy when the time comes!
921003.ch: 世上没有后悔药，到时候可别跪地求饶！

921004.ch: 过不了几分钟你就会后悔的！

922001.en: I really need to win this bout. Have mercy on me. I have a {0} here. Would you like it?
922001.ch: 我急需这场比试的胜利，万望阁下高抬贵手成人之美，此处有{0}奉上，不知阁下能否接受？

922002.en: I really need to win this bout. If you let me win, I will give you this precious {0}. What do you say?
922002.ch: 这场比试对我而言十分重要，我把珍藏多年的{0}给你，你能否让我获胜？

923001.en: If you do, I swear I will pay you back one day.
923001.ch: 当真如此，在下日后必有回报。

923002.en: Thanks in advance! I hope you keep your word, Cultivator.
923002.ch: 在下先行谢过，望道友遵守约定。

924001.ch: 这样啊，那好吧，你动手便是。

924002.en: Very well. Let our steel do the talking.
924002.ch: 好，那你我手底下见真章。

924003.en: In that case, I'll give it everything I've got. Let's fight!
924003.ch: 那么我只能全力以赴了，接招吧！

925001.en: You kept your promise. I owe you one.
925001.ch: 你信守承诺，在下欠你一个人情。

925002.ch: 阁下相让之恩，在下必有回报。

925003.en: I was right about you. You are definitely worth getting to know!
925003.ch: 我果然没有看错你，你是个值得结交之人！

926001.en: You brazenly broke your word! Just you wait...
926001.ch: 光天化日，你竟敢背叛先前约定，咱们走着瞧！

926002.en: Urgh! Low-life! You took my stuff and then broke your word. You'll get yours, one day!
926002.ch: 可恶！无耻小人，竟然收了东西翻脸不认账，你早晚必遭报应！

926003.en: Charlatan! I should never have trusted you!
926003.ch: 我早该料到你是这等阴险货色，白瞎了我对你的信任！

927001.en: I heard this item was very valuable. Now I see it, I can see why! I bid {0} Spirit Stones!

927002.en: It really is the {1}! I must have it! {0} Spirit Stones!

927003.en: I must have that {1}. {0} Spirit Stones is a small price to pay!
927003.ch: 这件{1}在下势在必得，区区{0}灵石不足挂齿！

927004.en: Could it be the legendary {1}? Here, {0} Spirit Stones!

927007.en: I have not seen this {1} for ten years. I must it. {0} Spirit Stones!

929017.en: Hilarious. You really think you stand a chance at securing such a treasure? PMSL!
929017.ch: 可笑可笑，我说{call|B|C}，如此重宝也是你能惦记的？不自量力！

929018.en: {call|B|C}, you should put those Spirit Stones away for your retirement. Why embarrass yourself?
929018.ch: {call|B|C}，你那点灵石还是留着养老吧，何必自取其辱？

929019.en: Those Spirit Stones going to your head, {call|B|C}? If you keep bidding against me, they won't even cover your doctor's bills!
929019.ch: 有几块灵石就飘了？{call|B|C}，你若执意跟我抬价，这点灵石都不够你养伤的！

929020.en: You like bidding, huh? Keep going {call|B|C}, and I will shove those Spirit Stones down your throat.
929020.ch: 喜欢抬价是吧？{call|B|C}，过不了多久我把你的嘴堵上！

929021.en: Certain people aren't ensnared by monsters, but by their own kind... wouldn't you say, {call|B|C}?
929021.ch: 某些人别是没栽在妖兽脚下，倒栽在同类手里，{call|B|C}你觉得我说得对吗？

929022.en: Certain people might be able to afford this {1}, but then never get the opportunity to use it. What do you say, {call|B|C}?
929022.ch: 这{1}，只怕某些人是有钱买、没机会用啊，{call|B|C}以为如何？

929023.en: I can obtain the things I want directly or indirectly. Your call, {call|B|C}.
929023.ch: 在下看上的东西，只有直接得到和间接得到两种结果，{call|B|C}你看着办吧。

929024.en: Do not infuriate me, {call|B|C}. If I decide to attack you, this flimsy Auction House won't protect you!
929024.ch: {call|B|C}，你莫逼我动怒，我一旦出手，这区区拍卖行也保不住你！

929025.en: Go back to where you came from, {call|B|C}. Your kind aren't welcome here.
929025.ch: {call|B|C}，识相点就哪来的回哪去，这里不是你撒野的地方。

929026.en: I'm warning you, {call|B|C}, you should donate your unspent Spirit Stones to the needy. Karma can be a bitch.
929026.ch: 我警告你{call|B|C}，灵石没地方花可以捐给需要的人，不要给自己找麻烦。

929027.en: You're looking rusty, {call|B|C}. You should spend your Spirit Stones on extra tuition. What do you say?
929027.ch: {call|B|C}，我看你是欠练了，把这点灵石拿去巩固已会的三招两式不好吗？

929028.en: I say {call|B|C}, you're looking for trouble if you spend all your Spirit Stones here. You should go and buy some protective elixirs at the market!
929028.ch: 我说{call|B|C}，与其在此处花灵石找罪受，不如去坊市买点丹药防身。

929029.en: {call|B|C}, I won't forget you bid against me today. Don't expect a friendly greeting, if I meet you on the streets.
929029.ch: {call|B|C}，今日抬价之仇我记下了，若是日后相遇，可别怪我冷酷无情。

929030.en: I knew you were up to no good, {call|B|C}. If you want to take it further, you'd better say your prayers.
929030.ch: 我就知道你没安好心，{call|B|C}，既要与我磕到底，便做好觉悟吧。

929031.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. You're a generous person, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not haggle with a child?
929031.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}大人宽宏大量，想必不会与孩儿计较。

929032.en: This {1} is very important to me. You have a generous spirit, {call|B|C}. You wouldn't pit yourself against a child, would you?
929032.ch: 这{1}对孩儿颇为重要，{call|B|C}大人纵横八荒，不至于与孩儿相争吧？

929033.en: We are family. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929033.ch: 本是一家人，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929034.en: If you withdraw now {call|B|C}, our relationship will remain intact. After all, the child should always obey the parent. Otherwise...
929034.ch: 若{call|B|C}就此收手，则你我亲情仍在，孩儿自当尽孝，如若不然……

929035.en: There's lots of things I admire about you, {call|B|C}, but you don't always want the best for others. You even play hardball with kids!
929035.ch: 孩儿观{call|B|C}万般皆好，只是不懂成人之美，与孩儿竟也要明着算账。

929036.en: {call|B|C}, I always try to be obedient, so why do you keep pushing up the price, making me look foolish?
929036.ch: {call|B|C}，孩儿素来孝顺，您何故行此等抬价之事，让孩儿难堪。

929037.en: I know you care dearly for your children, {call|B|C}. Might I ask you to withdraw and allow me to have this treasure?
929037.ch: 我知晓{call|B|C}素来疼爱孩儿，敢问您能否就此收手，圆孩儿得宝之梦？

929038.en: If you insist on bidding against me for this {1}, {call|B|C}, it will divide our house.
929038.ch: {call|B|C}若执意与孩儿争抢这{1}，只恐闹得家庭不睦、天伦难享。

929039.en: {call|B|C}, I can't believe you're the one who's bidding against me! I feel heartbroken.
929039.ch: {call|B|C}，没想到与孩儿争夺宝物之人竟会是您！实在令孩儿失望至极。

929040.en: I want travel the world with you, as your companion, {call|B|C}, so why would you stand in my way? Shame really.
929040.ch: 本欲与{call|B|C}携手相伴、遨游八荒，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于孩儿，实在可惜。

929041.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. You're a generous person, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not haggle with your Disciple?
929041.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}大人宽宏大量，想必不会与徒儿计较。

929042.en: This {1} is very important to me. You have a generous spirit, {call|B|C}. You wouldn't pit yourself against your own Disciple, would you?
929042.ch: 这{1}对徒儿颇为重要，{call|B|C}大人纵横八荒，不至于与徒儿相争吧？

929043.en: Master and Disciple are like family. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929043.ch: 师徒如父子，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929044.en: If you withdraw now {call|B|C}, our relationship will remain intact. After all, the Disciple should always obey the Master. Otherwise...
929044.ch: 若{call|B|C}就此收手，则师恩仍在，徒儿自当尽孝，如若不然……

929045.en: There's lots of things I admire about you, {call|B|C}, but you don't always want the best for others. You even play hardball with your own Disciples!
929045.ch: 徒儿观{call|B|C}万般皆好，只是不懂成人之美，与徒儿竟也要明着算账。

929047.en: I know you care dearly for your Disciples, {call|B|C}. Might I ask you to withdraw and allow me to have this treasure?
929047.ch: 我知晓{call|B|C}素来疼爱徒儿，敢问您能否就此收手，圆徒儿得宝之梦？

929048.en: If you insist on bidding against me for this {1}, {call|B|C}, it will divide us.
929048.ch: {call|B|C}若执意与徒儿争抢这{1}，只恐闹得师门不睦、天伦难享。

929051.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. You're a magnanimous person, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not stoop to haggling?
929051.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}器宇不凡，想必不会与在下纠缠。

929052.en: This {1} is very important to me. You are a prince among men, {call|B|C}. You wouldn't pit yourself against me, would you?
929052.ch: 这{1}对在下颇为重要，{call|B|C}乃人中龙凤，不至于与在下相争吧？

929053.en: You and I get on so well. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929053.ch: 你我素来交好，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929054.en: If you withdraw now {call|B|C}, our relationship will remain intact—we'll still be on speaking terms. Otherwise...
929054.ch: 若{call|B|C}就此收手，则你我交情仍在，日后有话好说，如若不然……

929055.en: There's lots of things I admire about you, {call|B|C}, but you don't always want the best for others. You even play hardball with me!
929055.ch: 在下观{call|B|C}万般皆好，只是不懂成人之美，竟偏要与在下过不去。

929056.en: {call|B|C}, I always try to be honest, so why do you keep pushing up the price, making me look foolish?
929056.ch: {call|B|C}，在下素来坦诚相待，阁下何故行此等抬价之事，让在下难堪。

929057.en: I know you are loyal to our code, {call|B|C}. Might I ask you to withdraw and let me have this boon?
929057.ch: 我知晓{call|B|C}素来义字当头，敢问{call|B|C}能否就此收手，让在下了却此番心愿？

929058.en: If you insist on bidding against me for this {1}, {call|B|C}, it will turn us against each other.
929058.ch: {call|B|C}若执意与在下争抢这{1}，只恐闹得你我恩断义绝、反目成仇。

929060.en: I want travel the world with you, as your close friend, {call|B|C}, so why would you stand in my way? Shame really.
929060.ch: 本欲与{call|B|C}结为至交、同游八荒，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于在下，实在可惜。

929061.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. You're a magnanimous person, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not stoop to haggling with your brother?
929061.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}器宇不凡，想必不会与手足纠缠。

929063.en: You and I share a brotherly bond. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929063.ch: 你我手足情深，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929065.en: There's lots of things I admire about you, {call|B|C}, but you don't always want the best for others. You even play hardball with your own brother!
929065.ch: 在下观{call|B|C}万般皆好，只是不懂成人之美，竟偏要与自家手足过不去。

929067.en: I know you are a very capable and loyal person, {call|B|C}. Might I ask you to withdraw and let me have this boon?
929067.ch: 我知晓{call|B|C}素来重情重义，敢问{call|B|C}能否就此收手，让手足了却此番心愿？

929071.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. You're a magnanimous person, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not stoop to haggling with your own sect members?
929071.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}器宇不凡，想必不会与同门纠缠。

929072.en: This {1} is very important to me. You are the pride of the sect, {call|B|C}. You wouldn't pit yourself against a fellow sect member, would you?
929072.ch: 这{1}对在下颇为重要，{call|B|C}乃宗门翘楚，不至于与同门相争吧？

929073.en: You and I are of the same sect. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929073.ch: 你我既属同门，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929075.en: There's lots of things I admire about you, {call|B|C}, but you don't always want the best for others. You even play hardball with your own sect member.
929075.ch: 在下观{call|B|C}万般皆好，只是不懂成人之美，竟偏要与同门好友过不去。

929078.en: If you insist on bidding against me for this {1}, {call|B|C}, it will divide our sect.
929078.ch: {call|B|C}若执意与在下争抢这{1}，只恐闹得你我恩断义绝、同门相残。

929081.en: It is said a gentleman does not take advantage of others. We have a deep attachment, {call|B|C}. Surely you would not inconvenience your lover?
929081.ch: 俗话说君子不夺人所好，{call|B|C}情深义重，想必不会为难挚爱。

929082.en: This {1} is very important to me. You hold a special place in my heart, {call|B|C}. You wouldn't pit yourself against your lover, would you?
929082.ch: 这{1}对在下颇为重要，{call|B|C}乃我钟情之人，不会要和爱侣相争吧？

929083.en: You and I are lovers. It makes no sense for us to bid against one another. Please think it over, {call|B|C}.
929083.ch: 你我伉俪情深，互相抬价彼此争夺实属不智之举，还望{call|B|C}三思而行。

929086.en: {call|B|C}, I try to respect you, so why do you keep pushing up the price, making me look foolish?
929086.ch: {call|B|C}，在下素来敬你如宾，你又何故行此等抬价之事，让在下难堪。

929087.en: I know you are a very capable and loyal person, {call|B|C}, so why don't you withdraw and let me have this boon?
929087.ch: 我知晓{call|B|C}素来重情重义，那何不就此收手，让爱侣了却此番心愿？

929088.en: If you insist on bidding against me for this {1}, {call|B|C}, it will split us up.
929088.ch: {call|B|C}若执意与在下争抢这{1}，只恐闹得你我劳燕分飞、破镜难圆。

929090.en: I want us to travel the world and grow old together, {call|B|C}, so why would you stand in my way? Shame really.
929090.ch: 本欲与{call|B|C}白头偕老、同游八荒，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于爱侣，实在可惜。

929091.en: It is said of all the virtues, filiality comes the first. You presume too much, {call|B|C}. Do not bid against me again.
929091.ch: 俗话说百善孝为先，{call|B|C}莫要放肆，不得再与为父出价争抢。

929092.en: This {1} is very important to me. Even if you surpass me, {call|B|C}, do not forget where you came from!
929092.ch: 这{1}对为父颇为重要，{call|B|C}青出于蓝，但也万万不可忘本！

929093.en: As my child, bidding against me is a disrespectful act, and I hope you won't repeat it, {call|B|C}.
929093.ch: 你既是我之子女，抬价争抢便实属不孝之举，还望{call|B|C}知错能改。

929095.en: Nothing can be accomplished without norms or standards, {call|B|C}. Playing hardball with your father is disrespectful and offends the natural order.
929095.ch: {call|B|C}可知没有规矩不成方圆，如今竟偏要与为父过不去，有违人伦，天道不允。

929096.en: {call|B|C}, have I ever mistreated you? So why do you keep pushing up the price, making me look foolish?
929096.ch: {call|B|C}，为父平日可曾亏待于你？如今你却何故行此等抬价之事，让为父难堪。

929097.en: I know you are a loyal and filial person, {call|B|C}. I know you were just fooling around before. Never do it again.
929097.ch: 为父知晓{call|B|C}素来孝悌忠信，之前权当与为父玩笑，以后切勿如此行为。

929099.en: I can't believe you're bidding against me, {call|B|C}! What is the world coming to?!
929099.ch: {call|B|C}，没想到与为父争夺宝物之人竟会是你！这真是滑天下之大稽！

929100.en: I want to protect you {call|B|C}, and for there to be no secrets between us, so why would you stand in my way? Such a disappointment.
929100.ch: 本欲与{call|B|C}推心置腹，护你一路周全，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于为父，实在可恼。

929105.en: Nothing can be accomplished without norms or standards, {call|B|C}. Playing hardball with your mother is disrespectful and offends the natural order.
929105.ch: {call|B|C}可知没有规矩不成方圆，如今竟偏要与为娘过不去，有违人伦，天道不允。

929109.en: I can't believe you're bidding against me, {call|B|C}! What's the world coming to?!
929109.ch: {call|B|C}，没想到与为娘争夺宝物之人竟会是你！这真是滑天下之大稽！

929110.en: I want protect you {call|B|C}, and for there to be no secrets between us, so why would you stand in my way? So disappointing.
929110.ch: 本欲与{call|B|C}推心置腹，护你一路周全，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于为娘，实在可恼。

929113.en: As my Disciple, bidding against me is a disrespectful act, and I hope you won't repeat it, {call|B|C}.
929113.ch: 你既是我之爱徒，抬价争抢便实属不孝之举，还望{call|B|C}知错能改。

929115.en: Nothing can be accomplished without norms or standards, {call|B|C}. Playing hardball with your Master is disrespectful and offends the natural order.
929115.ch: {call|B|C}可知没有规矩不成方圆，如今竟偏要与为师过不去，有违人伦，天道不允。

929120.en: I want protect you {call|B|C}, and teach you all my tricks, so why would you stand in my way? So disappointing.
929120.ch: 本欲对{call|B|C}倾囊相授，护你一路周全，奈何{call|B|C}竟为难于为师，实在可恼。

930001.en: You guys know I love this {1} and still you keep bidding. Did you think I wouldn't notice? I bid {0} Spirit Stones.
930001.ch: 你等明知我钟意这{1}，还一再抬价，莫非想引起我的注意不成？我出{0}灵石。

930002.en: I bid {0} Spirit Stones. The Path of Cultivation is hard. Fellow travelers should not work against one another.
930002.ch: 我出价{0}灵石，修仙之路本就艰险无比，修仙者之间更不应该互相掣肘，这不好。

930003.en: Huh. Pushing up the price, and for what? Go mediate on a mountaintop, why don't you? {0} Spirit Stones!
930003.ch: 哼，与其在此处抬价，不如找个偏僻所在修炼两天。我出{0}灵石！

930004.en: Some people bid just for the hell of it. So ridiculous. I offer {0} Spirit Stones. I'm trusting you to do the right thing, everyone.
930004.ch: 某些人非要抬价，一抬再抬，真是贻笑大方。我出{0}灵石，希望诸位好自为之。

930005.en: I'm gonna to take that last bid as a joke... but if you insist on bidding, expect no mercy. I offer {0} Spirit Stones.
930005.ch: 方才出价，我权当诸位玩笑，若还要硬争，休怪我不客气。我出{0}灵石。

930006.en: I understand your interest, but count up your Spirit Stones. Can they match my bid of {0} Spirit Stones?
930006.ch: 诸位见宝起意可以理解，但也请算好怀中灵石，是我{0}灵石出价的对手么？

930007.en: I advise you all to stop bidding, otherwise who knows what might happen? Hopefully my {0} Spirit Stones will be enough.
930007.ch: 我劝诸位莫要再行争宝，否则后果难以预料，我{0}灵石希望是成交价格。

930008.en: Why not save some Spirit Stones for a rainy day? You don't know what the future holds. I offer {0} Spirit Stones.
930008.ch: 抬价之人何不留足灵石以待将来？若与我拼斗恐难以收场。我出{0}灵石。

930009.en: It's one thing to like an object, but a bidding war will hurt us both. Think it over. I offer {0} Spirit Stones.
930009.ch: 虽说此宝珍惜异常，但胡乱争夺只会两败俱伤，望尔等慎思。我出{0}灵石。

930010.en: Bid all you want, but my {0} Spirit Stones will settle the matter. No sense in fighting.
930010.ch: 各位抬价几次也就罢了，我这{0}灵石势必拿下此宝，你等不必挣扎。

930011.en: Why endanger your reputation? The capable man finds treasure wherever he goes. Why not just let me have it, for {0} Spirit Stones?
930011.ch: 你等何苦争夺失了身份，能人自可于八荒界中任意得宝。{0}灵石让于我可好？

930012.en: You're pushing your luck. I'm a tolerant person, but my patience is wearing very thin. I bid {0} Spirit Stones!
930012.ch: 尔等莫要得寸进尺，我再三容忍，真当我好欺负不成？我出{0}灵石！

930013.en: C'mon, let's get this over with! {0} Spirit Stones, if you please!
930013.ch: 人的耐心是有限的，三番五次折腾不如给个痛快！在下{0}灵石，诸位请便！

930014.en: Okay, sh*t just got real. Don't think I won't slap you. {0} Spirit Stones. Who dares challenge me?
930014.ch: 我不发话，你莫非真当我是木雕泥塑之人？{0}灵石我看谁还敢加！

930015.en: You're really asking for trouble now. I bid {0} Spirit Stones. Don't embarrass yourselves.
930015.ch: 屡次招惹于我，真不怕惹祸上身吗？我出价{0}灵石，某些人莫要自找无趣！

930016.en: If you keep bidding, you'll never walk out of this Auction House alive! I bid {0} Spirit Stones!
930016.ch: 阁下要是再敢抬价，在下有一百种方法让你走不出这拍卖行！我出{0}灵石！

930017.en: Just shake out your wallet and be done with it! {0} Spirit Stones! Can you handle THAT?!
930017.ch: 有俩臭钱就不能一次性抖落出来吗？我这{0}灵石，就问你还能吃得住吗？

930018.en: You can forget about it! {0} Spirit Stones is small change to me. You like bidding? Go on then! BID!!!
930018.ch: 你休得放肆！{0}灵石对我而言还不叫事，不是喜欢抬价吗，来呀，继续呀！

930019.en: You leave me with no choice! {0} Spirit Stones! I'll die before I let you have it.
930019.ch: 呔！你非要把我逼上绝路不可么？这是{0}灵石，此宝我誓死不让！

930020.en: Don't burn your bridges. Nothing good can come of it! I bid {0} Spirit Stones!
930020.ch: 我劝你做人留一线，磕到最后你必然没有好下场！我出{0}灵石！

930021.en: Don't push me! You don't want to see me when I get angry! {0} Spirit Stones!
930021.ch: 你最好别真把我逼急了，我的怒火你承受不起！加到{0}灵石！

930022.en: Holy cow! Looks like it's a fight to the death! I bid {0} Spirit Stones! Any more challengers?!
930022.ch: 哇呀呀呀呀！看来今日非得不死不休了！我出{0}灵石！还有谁！！

930023.en: I'll happily bid my whole fortune on this item! {0} Spirit Stones! Do your worst!
930023.ch: 为了这件宝物，这全部家当不要也罢，{0}灵石！我跟你拼了！！

930024.en: Well that's torn it. Now you've pissed me off and I'm not backing down! {0} Spirit Stones!
930024.ch: 储物袋已撕，{0}灵石！就我这小暴脾气，今日必要跟你拼到最后！

930025.en: Haha-hahaha! Don't think I'm done yet! {0} Spirit Stones! I raise you!
930025.ch: 哈哈，哈哈哈，别以为我就这样倒下了！{0}灵石，我让你抬，我让你抬！

930026.en: You didn't think you got it, did you? I'm still wearing my shirt. I bid {0} Spirit Stones!
930026.ch: 不会吧，不会以为自己拿下了吧？把我底裤当了去，我出{0}灵石！

930027.en: You've taken it too far. I warn you—it's life or death! A paltry {0} Spirit Stones!
930027.ch: 今日你欺我太甚，我誓要与你拼个鱼死网破！不过是{0}灵石罢了！

930028.en: You don't know when to quit, do you? You and I are through! {0} Spirit Stones... Whatever it takes!
930028.ch: 到如今你还苦苦相逼，我与你势不两立！这{0}灵石再心痛我也要花！

930029.en: You really wanna go there?! {0} Spirit Stones! Read 'em and WEEP!
930029.ch: 竟然与我死磕到底，这八荒界将无你容身之地！{0}灵石让你绝望！

930030.en: Play with fire, you're gonna get burned. {0} Spirit Stones. Hand it over!
930030.ch: 你既决意惹怒于我，发生意外必是早晚的事。{0}灵石给我拿下！！

930031.en: Still not finished, huh?! You think beating me is worth {0} Spirit Stones?
930031.ch: 没完了是吧！您看我这脑袋还值不值{0}灵石？

931001.en: Hahaha! Thank you, everyone. May your kindness be rewarded!
931001.ch: 哈哈哈，承蒙厚爱，诸位成人之美，日后必得大道。

931002.en: Hahaha! Thank you, fellow Cultivators. I shall treasure this {1}.
931002.ch: 哈哈哈，多谢众位道友拱手相让，这{1}在下就笑纳了。

931003.en: Hahaha! Looks like this {1} has my name on it. Getting it wasn't even that hard in the end!
931003.ch: 哈哈哈，看来这{1}与我有缘，得之竟不费吹灰之力。

931004.en: Haha! I got the {1}. Wonderful. I'm really glad I made the trip.
931004.ch: 哈哈，如此甚好，能捡漏这{1}，真可谓不虚此行。

931005.en: The fortune teller said I would have some good luck. I wasn't expecting it to happen here though. Whoopee!
931005.ch: 真人卜得我近日有一桩美事，没想到应验于此，妙哉！

931006.en: Since no one is bidding against me, I will reluctantly take this item. Haha!
931006.ch: 既是无人与我相争，在下就勉为其难将其收下了，哈哈。

931007.en: Oh, how the tables have turned! Look who's laughing now! Haha!
931007.ch: 风水轮流转，今日我竟如此轻易地得偿所愿，实在快哉！

931008.en: I'm the only one who perceived the value of this {1}! No matter. Everyone will hear of it soon.
931008.ch: 看来只有我能勘破这{1}之妙处，无妨，我自会扬其威名。

931009.en: Hahaha! You chumps let me have a bargain!
931009.ch: 哈哈哈，八荒界竟无识货之人，倒要让我捡了天大便宜！

931010.en: No one has bid against me. I see you do know which way the wind is blowing. You have my thanks.
931010.ch: 无人与我相争，果然众位皆是识时务之辈，在下谢过。

931011.en: Haha! Thanks for doing me this honor guys. Of course we're still be on speaking terms.
931011.ch: 哈哈，诸位既给在下三分薄面，日后相见自然有话好说。

931012.en: Knowing that I won it, the cost doesn't bother me all that much. Hnnng...
931012.ch: 一想到宝物到手，多花的这点灵石也就无甚所谓了，哼哼。

931013.en: I knew it wouldn't be easy, but the outcome was still within my budget.
931013.ch: 我早料到取此物不会一帆风顺，这个结果还在我的计算之中。

931014.en: You might be a bit wet behind the ears, but you're clearly not stupid. I will be taking this {1} then...
931014.ch: 也罢，虽有些许不开眼之辈，但倒还懂事，这{1}我就收下了。

931015.en: Well this {1} is something, I guess. A matter of a few Spirit Stones. Spend them and they're gone.
931015.ch: 能得到这{1}，我也算有所收获，灵石事小，花也就花了。

931016.en: Well, now that I own it, it's a bit underwhelming, I'll be honest with you.
931016.ch: 吁，想到此宝就要为我所有，这一番波折也就无足挂齿了。

931017.en: You pissed me off just now, but I'm in a good mood and I'm gonna let it slide.
931017.ch: 虽然有人妄图惹事，但在下今日心情大好，既然得宝便不多追究了。

931018.en: Oh, that was quick. I thought there was another big shot out there bidding against me.
931018.ch: 哎呀，幸福来得有些突然，我还以为有哪位大能与我争抢。

931019.en: That's it? That was easy! I guess that {1} really did have my name on it, haha.
931019.ch: 这就完了？根本不痛不痒嘛，这{1}还是与我有缘呐，哈哈。

931020.en: Knowing when to quit shows you're intelligent. You'll live longer that way.
931020.ch: 知难而退说明你也是个聪慧之人，如此方能在八荒界活得长久。

931021.en: Withdrawing was the right choice. I admire your flexibility. I'll take that {1}!
931021.ch: 不与我争下去实乃明智之选，我敬你等识时务，这{1}我便收下了。

931022.en: It took a bit longer than I would have liked, but the outcome was still worth the struggle!
931022.ch: 虽然过程甚是曲折，但看样子结果还是好的，不枉我一番辛劳！

931023.en: I told you it would come to me, despite the senseless bleating of several non-entities.
931023.ch: 我早说此物合该归我，某人非要做些无谓挣扎，真是庸人自扰。

931024.en: What that hell guys? You haggle with me for hours only to let me have it! Hahaha!
931024.ch: 诸位这是怎么了？争抢了半天，竟要把宝物让于在下不成？哈哈哈。

931025.en: You really embarrassed yourself back there. File that one under D for Dumbass. Hahaha!
931025.ch: 争而不得只落得自己难堪，尔等之后你也该长点记性了吧，哈哈哈。

931026.en: I knew it. What was all that fuss about? Hand it over, there's a good boy.
931026.ch: 早知如此，又何必闹得一场不快？乖乖把宝物献给在下不就是了。

931027.en: Hah! No money or no backbone and you still thought you could get that {1}? Delusional.
931027.ch: 哼，没点财力和毅力也想从我手中夺得这{1}？真是痴心妄想。

931028.en: Hahaha, some people have no self-awareness. Going up against me is a recipe for humiliation.
931028.ch: 哈哈哈，某些人就是没有自知之明，竟与我争抢，活该丢人现眼。

931029.en: You done? Come on! Otherwise that {1} is mine!
931029.ch: 怎么停手了？别介呀，再不出价这{1}就要归我了！

931030.en: I didn't plan on bidding, but Heaven had other ideas. Now we know the score!
931030.ch: 我本不想露白，奈何天不遂人愿，现在该知道谁是你抬不起的人了吧！

931031.en: Quitting so soon? I thought you guys were serious contenders. I wish I'd known earlier! Haha!
931031.ch: 我还当你等多有能耐，扑腾两下就不灵了？早知如此何必当初，哈哈。

931032.en: C'MON!!! What are you waiting for? (Coughing)... C'MON!!! I'll take you all! Hahaha!
931032.ch: 还有谁！呼呼，某些人不是很能吗？咳咳咳……还有谁！统统来啊！哈哈哈！

931033.en: How dare you vermin try to humiliate me! Anyway, I got it in the end. It was worth it!
931033.ch: 一群蝼蚁，竟把我逼到这般窘境，不过也罢，若得此宝，一切都值了！

931034.en: Hahaha! A pauper army come to do battle! Where is your champion? What a sorry bunch of clowns you are!
931034.ch: 哈哈哈！一个能打的都没有，一堆穷鬼还想和我比斗？都是跳梁小丑罢了！

931035.en: Hawhaw, y'all done? Such a tiny serving, too rich for your palate? Hahaha, I guess so.
931035.ch: 嚯嚯，终于都倒下了么？这么点钱就全都吃不消了？哈哈哈，不过如此嘛。

931036.en: Anyone else? You're not very good at this are you? That's too bad. I was just getting started!
931036.ch: 还有人出价吗？不是很能抬价吗？这咋突然都熄火了？这钱我还没花个痛快呢！

931037.en: Keep bidding, don't mind me! I've spent enough Spirit Stones for today. But don't think you got away with it!
931037.ch: 抬价啊，千万别跟我客气！今天这灵石我是花够了，你们一个个也别想有好！

931038.en: Hmm... Even if I got that {1}, don't think I'd forgive you. We ain't done!
931038.ch: 呼呼，就算我得到这{1}，也别以为我会放过你们，这事儿咱完不了！

931039.en: Hahahaha, though the devil stand in my way, I shall have that treasure. Spirit Stones, Spirit Stones fare thee well!
931039.ch: 哈哈哈哈，虽有妖魔从中作祟，但我终要把此宝收入囊中，灵石灵石，你且去也！

931040.en: This {1} is a real treasure. It's only right that I should pass through many ordeals before acquiring it!
931040.ch: 这{1}本不同凡响，我经历如此磨难将其取到也是此物对我的考验，罢了罢了！

931041.en: Told you to drop out while you were ahead. You'll just have to learn the hard way. Not your lucky day...
931041.ch: 告诉你们趁早放弃，真是不见棺材不掉泪，遇到我算你们倒霉，咳咳咳。

932001.en: If you feel so strongly about it, I guess I'll just have to give it up.
932001.ch: 你若执意如此，我只好忍痛割爱了。

932002.ch: 既然如此，我且答应便是了。

932003.en: How could I ever refuse you?
932003.ch: 你既开口，我哪有不从之理？

932004.en: Well, in that case, I'll play along as a favor.
932004.ch: 既然这样，我便顺水推舟卖个人情。

932005.en: This {1} is valuable, but I value your good opinion more.
932005.ch: 这{1}虽贵，但我更看重你的诚意。

932006.en: Fine, you keep bidding. I withdraw.
932006.ch: 行，你且出价，我不争便是。

932007.en: Do you really have to ask? I thought we were closer than that.
932007.ch: 你我之间还提请求，未免见外了吧。

932008.ch: 但有何事，尽管对我言讲便是！

932009.en: I really want that {1}, but I hate fighting with you.
932009.ch: 我虽想要这{1}，但着实不愿与你相争。

932010.en: I shall permit it. You may go.
932010.ch: 今日之事在下应允，阁下可以走了。

933002.en: I want you to have it, but I really need it. Sorry.
933002.ch: 我虽有心让你，但此物着实与我有用，恕难从命。

933003.en: Sorry, but I also have my reasons for keeping it {1}.
933003.ch: 恕在下不从，我也有必得这{1}的理由。

933004.en: You and I do get on well, but at the Auction House we let our money do the talking. Nuff said.
933004.ch: 你我虽交好，但拍卖会上以财力论高低，不必多言。

933005.ch: 东西你且收回，此事我不能答应。

933006.en: I'm happy to discuss anything else, but not that {1}.
933006.ch: 若是其他事情尚能商量，这{1}我万不能让。

933007.en: It's about the {1}. I'm not doing this for fun. Please try to understand.
933007.ch: 这{1}事关重大，并非我有意得罪，还请你理解。

933008.en: Every man and his dog wants this thing. It's not up to me. Don't blame the messenger.
933008.ch: 此物牵扯甚广，非我能定夺，你莫要怪罪于我。

933009.en: You think they will stop me getting the {1}? Keep dreaming.
933009.ch: 用这些东西就想阻我得到{1}？真乃痴人说梦。

933010.en: You think that junk can distract me? You trying to trick me?
933010.ch: 这点破烂就想打发在下，你莫非有意戏弄于我？

934005.en: If you love it so much, I guess I'll just have to pull out.
934005.ch: 你若钟意此物，我除了退出也别无他法。

934007.en: You and I are like peas in a pod. What is mine is yours.
934007.ch: 你我之间亲密无间，我的就是你的。

935005.en: If you think I'm a pushover, you've got another thing coming.
935005.ch: 你以为我是那种会轻易屈服的软弱之人吗？

935009.en: You think a few cross words will stop me getting the {1}? Keep dreaming.
935009.ch: 几句狠话就想阻我得到{1}？真乃痴人说梦。

935010.ch: 也不掂量掂量自己的分量，竟想威胁于我，可笑可笑。

936001.en: If you let me have the {1}, I will give you my {2}.
936001.ch: 你若答应将{1}让于我，在下自有薄礼{2}奉上。

936002.en: Please accept this {2} as a small token of my appreciation. Would you mind withdrawing from the auction for the {1}?
936002.ch: 这{2}算我的一点心意，烦请阁下收下后，退出{1}的竞价。

936003.en: Pull out of the bidding and this {2} can be yours.
936003.ch: 若你愿意就此罢手，这{2}就归你所有了。

936004.en: Take this {2} and pull out of the bidding. Then we both get what we want.
936004.ch: 这{2}赠予阁下，还望你退出竞拍，你我各取所需。

936005.en: This {2} is priceless. Pull out and you can have it. Waddaya say?
936005.ch: 这{2}价值不菲，只要退出竞价其便归你，你看可好？

936006.en: I'd be willing to part with this {2} of you stop bidding on the {1}. What do you say?
936006.ch: 我忍痛用这{2}换你不再出价竞拍{1}，你意下如何？

936007.en: Stop bidding and this {2} can be yours. It's a win-win. What do you say?
936007.ch: 你若放弃出价，这{2}便归你所有，此乃双赢之举，望你思之。

936008.en: I really need this {1}. Here, take this {2} as a token of my good faith. How about pulling out now?
936008.ch: {1}于我有大用，这{2}聊表我的诚意，你就此退出可好？

936009.en: If you stop bidding for the {1}, you can have my {2}. Go on, take it.
936009.ch: 你若能退出{1}的竞价，我有薄礼{2}奉上，不成敬意。

936010.en: I wonder if this {2} can induce you pull out of the auction? Please, good master.
936010.ch: 我以这{2}不知能否请你退出竞价，万望阁下成全。

937002.en: You want to fight me for that {1}? I'll give you a second chance. Think it over.
937002.ch: 和我争抢{1}？给你一次重选的机会，你再想想吧。

937003.en: I placed a bid, so you should know what to do next. Do I really need to spell it out for you?
937003.ch: 我既出价，你应该知道该怎么做，还需在下言明？

937004.en: I want that {1}. Choose wisely. Don't make me do anything I will regret.
937004.ch: 这{1}我要定了，我劝你好自为之，别逼我做些出格之事。

937005.en: Keep bidding on that {1} and it will be too late to regrets.
937005.ch: 你若执意再对{1}出价，到时候后悔可就晚了！
